# AIR Core

AIR is a verifier-first programming language and CLI for bounded, deterministic components, including AI-authored logic.

Read first when writing AIR (the package and the repository carry it):
- In the npm package: node_modules/@underskys/air-core/docs/v0.53/AIR_FOR_MODELS.md (global install: $(npm root -g)/@underskys/air-core/docs/v0.53/AIR_FOR_MODELS.md)
- In the repository: docs/v0.53/AIR_FOR_MODELS.md (https://gitlab.com/fd.skyrealm/air-core/-/blob/main/docs/v0.53/AIR_FOR_MODELS.md)
- Examples: docs/v0.53/for-models/examples/ (each compiles, or is refused with the code the page states)
- Claude Code skill: skills/air/SKILL.md (copy the skills/air folder into .claude/skills/)
- A copy for people may also be published at https://air-core.dev/for-models/

Project facts:
- Project name: AIR
- npm package: @underskys/air-core
- CLI: airc
- Source extension: .air
- Source profiles: legacy-v0.50 (the default), typed-v0.51, and typed-v0.53, a candidate profile selected with --source-profile typed-v0.53 --allow-candidate-profile
- Check a typed-v0.53 file: airc check FILE --source-profile typed-v0.53 --allow-candidate-profile --lsp-json (stable air.* codes, line and repair hint as JSON)
- Run an airc that is already installed: node_modules/.bin/airc in a project that has @underskys/air-core, airc from a global install, or node bin/airc.js in the repository. If none exists, the code is unchecked: ask the user to install @underskys/air-core. Never fetch or run a tool by a package name through a package runner.
- AIR ABI 0.12 typed decisions is opt-in and may change before v1.0; AIR ABI 0.10 and 0.11 remain supported.
- Reference backend: WebAssembly (Wasm)
- The npm registry is the source of truth for published versions and dist-tags.

AIR modules declare imports, emits, capabilities, effects, and bounded execution. The verifier checks that declared boundary. Hosts retain filesystem, network, UI, rendering, assets, hardware, credentials, and platform authority.

AIR is unrelated to Adobe AIR.

Links:
- https://gitlab.com/fd.skyrealm/air-core
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/@underskys/air-core
- https://air-core.dev/
